newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo stocks end little changed, caution prevail.
newsitem.headline: Colombo stocks end little changed, caution prevail.

text.p: The Sri Lankan stocks closed barely changed on Friday when investors turned cautious as the all share index approached the psychological 600-level, brokers said.
The all share index closed 0.29 points higher at 592.33, just maintaining its upward trend which began on September 18.
"Investors are cautious as the all share comes close to 600 points, wondering when major profit-taking would restrain the index," said Prasanna Chandrasekera of brokerage John Keells.
Gainers and decliners ran virtually neck and neck at 19 to 18.
Turnover, supported by last minute deals by local and foreign institutional investors, was a healthy 30.67 million rupees.
Among actively trades shares were Blue Diamonds Jewellery, Pelwatte Sugar, Richard Pieris and Tea Smallholder Factories.
United Motors rose 2.25 rupees to 37.75 and Development Finance Corp 25 cents to 268.25 rupees.
